Read where you are.

Keep CopySpeak open. Your desktop voice, speed, and effects apply here too.

On the page

Website access

Hover reading and double-copy highlighting work on websites you allow below. Reading selected text with the toolbar or shortcut needs no saved website access.

    Read a selection

    Select text and click the CopySpeak toolbar icon, right-click → Read with CopySpeak, or press Alt + Shift + T (default shortcut).

    Open this page again from the extension’s right-click menu → CopySpeak Companion settings, or its Options entry. Browser settings pages, PDF viewers, and text editors are unsupported.
